title: Design and synthesis of 2-Substituted-4-benzyl-5-methylimidazoles as new potential Anti-breast cancer agents to inhibit oncogenic STAT3 functions.
authors: Beshay, Botros Y; Abdellatef, Amira A; Loksha, Yasser M; Fahmy, Salwa M; Habib, Nargues S; Bekhit, Alaa El-Din A; Georghiou, Paris E; Hayakawa, Yoshihiro; Bekhit, Adnan A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成咪唑类STAT3抑制剂并评估其抗乳腺癌活性，虽涉及STAT3蛋白功能抑制和分子对接建模，但核心是药物化学与细胞实验，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: STAT3 signaling is known to be associated with tumorigenesis and further cancer cell-intrinsic activation of STAT3 leads to altered regulation of several oncogenic processes. Given the importance of STAT3 in cancer development and progression particularly breast cancer, it is crucial to discover new chemical entities of STAT3 inhibitor to develop anti-breast cancer drug candidates. Herein, 4-benzyl-2-benzylthio-5-methyl-1H-imidazole (2a) and 4-benzyl-5-methyl-2-[(2,6-difluorobenzyl)thio]-1H-imidazole (2d) from a group of thirty imidazole-bearing compounds showed greater STAT3 inhibition than their lead compounds VS1 and the oxadiazole derivative MD77. Within all tested compounds, ten derivatives effectively inhibited the growth of the two tested breast cancer cells with IC(50) values ranging from 6.66 to 26.02 microM. In addition, the most potent derivatives 2a and 2d inhibited the oncogenic function of STAT3 as seen in the inhibition of colony formation and IL-6 production of breast cancer cell lines. Modeling studies provided evidence for the possible interactions of the synthesized compounds with the key residues of the STAT3-SH2 domain. Collectively, our present study suggests 2-substituted-4-benzyl-5-methylimidazoles are a new class of anti-cancer drug candidates to inhibit oncogenic STAT3 function.
abstract_zh: STAT3信号传导已知与肿瘤发生相关，且癌细胞内在的STAT3进一步激活会导致多种致癌过程的调控改变。鉴于STAT3在癌症发生和发展中的重要性，尤其是乳腺癌，发现新的STAT3抑制剂化学实体以开发抗乳腺癌药物候选物至关重要。在此，来自一组三十种含咪唑化合物中的4-苄基-2-苄硫基-5-甲基-1H-咪唑（2a）和4-苄基-5-甲基-2-[(2,6-二氟苄基)硫基]-1H-咪唑（2d）显示出比其先导化合物VS1和噁二唑衍生物MD77更强的STAT3抑制作用。在所有测试化合物中，十种衍生物有效抑制了两种测试乳腺癌细胞的生长，IC(50)值范围为6.66至26.02微摩尔。此外，最有效的衍生物2a和2d抑制了STAT3的致癌功能，如乳腺癌细胞系中集落形成和IL-6产生的抑制所示。建模研究为合成化合物与STAT3-SH2结构域关键残基的可能相互作用提供了证据。总体而言，我们的当前研究表明2-取代-4-苄基-5-甲基咪唑是一类新型抗癌药物候选物，可抑制致癌STAT3功能。
